test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 20 and 24 minutes, respectively, and a waste pipe can empty 3 gallons per minute. All the three pipes working together can fill the tank in 15 minutes. The capacity of the tank is:
solution:
Given:

Two pipes can fill a tank in 20 and 24 minutes respectively and a waste pipe can empty 3 gallons per minute. 

 All three pipes working together can fill the tank in 15 minutes. 

Formula used:

Capacity = Time × Efficiency

Calculation:

Let total capacity = LCM[20, 24, 15] = 120 units

E(1st Pipe) = 120/20 = 6

E(2nd Pipe) = 120/24 = 5 

E(All three Pipes) = 120/15= 8 [∵ Capacity = Time × Efficiency]

3rd Pipe = E(All three Pipes) - E(1st Pipe) - E(2nd Pipe)

⇒ 3rd Pipe = 8 - 6 - 5 = - 3 units 

[negative as 3rd Pipe is a waste pipe]

∴ 3rd Pipe empties 3 units every minute

According to the question,

3 units = 3 gallons.

Thus, Capacity of tank = (120/3) × 3 = 120 gallons

∴ Capacity of the tank is 120 gallons.
